remarks: Beautiful 3BR/2BA fully remodeled condo in West Norwalk's highly sought-after Ledgebrook community. This 1,650-square-foot unit offers privacy, space, and style, with an open-layout renovation that created a more spacious, bright, and functional living area. Enjoy a cozy double-sided brick fireplace between the dining and living areas. Corner unit with floor-to-ceiling windows. New Andersen energy-efficient windows, and sliding doors leading to a private, covered deck. New kitchen featuring custom cabinetry, under-cabinet lighting, new appliances, a large 33-inch sink, Kraus faucet, and a big island with double waterfall. New white oak hardwood floors, crown molding, and custom closets throughout. Large utility closet with full-size washer/dryer and extra storage. Oversized primary suite includes multiple closets and an en-suite master bath with heated floors and a cinnamon oak vanity with Carrara marble top. Two additional bedrooms provide flexible space for guests, an office, or hobbies. The second full bath features a Kohler vanity with quartz countertop and a deep soaking tub. Recent updates include all-new plumbing and electrical. Just minutes to train, shopping, dining, beaches, and golf. Community amenities include a pool, hot tub, sauna, clubhouse, and gym. Don't miss it!
